# SEO-503: Escape entry content so the feed remains well-formed

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |

| Minimum level | `RECOMMENDED` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Markup and reserved characters inside an entry's title or body are escaped or wrapped so the surrounding document stays parseable, whatever the item text contains.

## Rationale

Item text routinely contains characters that are reserved in the enclosing format, and inserting it unescaped turns a single apostrophe or ampersand in an article into a feed that fails to parse.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_feeds"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Let the serializer escape every text node rather than escaping selectively where a fault was once observed, and test the generator against item text containing reserved characters and embedded markup.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Parse the served feed and additionally generate it from fixture items containing reserved characters, confirming both parse without error.
- Evidence: `FEED`, `VALIDATOR_OUTPUT`, `BUILD_OUTPUT`
- Automated check: none.

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_NEWS`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
